sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Use this tool to check the status of a commercial lending or business equipment loan application and identify any outstanding customer tasks using the application number or case number.
When to call: - When a customer calls to check on their business loan application, financing request, or required documentation, and provides or is asked for their application/case number (e.g. LNB0001001).
Inputs to provide: - Pass the loan application number or case number (e.g. LNB0001001) to application_number or case_number.
Context to store: - Store the returned case_sys_id and contact_sys_id in conversation context.
Customer response: - Inform the customer of their application number, loan description, and that the application is currently in the Credit Assessment stage. - Clearly notify them of pending document requirements: Sales Agreement for Vehicle and Proof of Insurance. - Explain that these documents can be submitted either by uploading them directly through the customer portal or by emailing them to lending-documents@luminabank.com.
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.name: Look Up Lending Application
